title: Tiny, cute paint palette
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- palette body - wood brown -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="52" rx="38" ry="30" fill="#C98A4B"/>
  <!-- lighter rim highlight -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="52" rx="38" ry="30" fill="none" stroke="#E8B57A" stroke-width="3"/>
  <!-- thumb hole -->
  <ellipse cx="40" cy="62" rx="10" ry="8" fill="#7A4B1E"/>
  <ellipse cx="40" cy="62" rx="10" ry="8" fill="none" stroke="#A86D33" stroke-width="2.5"/>
  <!-- paint blobs -->
  <circle cx="30" cy="40" r="7" fill="#FF4D4D"/>
  <circle cx="30" cy="40" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#FF9C9C" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="48" cy="34" r="7" fill="#4DA6FF"/>
  <circle cx="48" cy="34" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#A8D4FF" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="66" cy="40" r="7" fill="#FFD84D"/>
  <circle cx="66" cy="40" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#FFF0A8" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="72" cy="56" r="7" fill="#6EE86E"/>
  <circle cx="72" cy="56" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#B8FFB8" stroke-width="2"/>
  <!-- tiny paintbrush -->
  <rect x="58" y="20" width="7" height="4" rx="1.5" fill="#E8B57A" transform="rotate(35 61 22)"/>
  <rect x="58" y="20" width="4" height="4" rx="1" fill="#FF9C9C" transform="rotate(35 61 22)"/>
  <rect x="62" y="25" width="2.5" height="20" rx="1.2" fill="#A86D33" transform="rotate(35 63 35)"/>
</svg>
